subject.title: Feature: preserve completed progress draft in Telegram progress mode

question: Should Telegram progress mode gain a default-off option that preserves the full completed progress draft with checklist-style state while sending the final answer as a separate normal message?
rationale: Current main intentionally collapses progress mode to a one-line summary, and adding full draft preservation plus checklist state creates a new public config and message lifecycle policy.

options.title: Accept Default-Off Preserve Mode
options.body: Add a documented Telegram-owned option for full completed-draft retention and checklist state while keeping today's collapse-summary behavior as the default.

options.title: Keep Current Summary Bar
options.body: Treat the existing one-line retained summary as the supported finalization UX and decline full completed-draft preservation for now.

options.title: Defer To Structured Progress Cards
options.body: Route this into a broader structured progress-card design so checklist state is not inferred from markdown/commentary text.

recommendation.title: Accept Default-Off Preserve Mode
recommendation.body: Add a documented Telegram-owned option for full completed-draft retention and checklist state while keeping today's collapse-summary behavior as the default.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent merged work owns the current collapse-summary implementation and schema surface this decision would extend.
